{

  "body": [
    {
      "type": "markdown",
      "attributes": {
        "value": "## Feature Request\n\nPlease describe the feature you'd like to see."
      }
    },
    {

      }

    {
      "type": "textarea",

    },
    {
      "type": "textarea",
      "attributes": {
        "label": "Hardware Considerations",

      }

  ]
